summary:

bullets: Partnered with Wells Fargo CIO Office to drive the transition of the Wealth & Investment Management (WIM) Advisory platform from legacy Host-Greenscreen to the modern Beta NXT Operations Workbench, ensuring business alignment, operational continuity, and seamless transition across functions.
